methodological_rigor.justification: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout in single HCT116 cell line. RT-qPCR and wound healing assays. Limited mechanistic depth. No independent replication, no animal models. Methodological scope minimal.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: In vitro only. No human tissue, animal models, or clinical validation. Speculative translational relevance.

reporting_quality.justification: Sparse methods detail. CRISPR off-target assessment not discussed. No data sharing statement.

novelty_literature.justification: CLDN2 in CRC progression previously characterized. Study confirms known associations without novel mechanism.

writing_presentation.justification: Brief report. Lacks mechanistic depth and substantial discussion.

key_strengths: CRISPR knockout demonstrates CLDN2 role in motility-associated gene networks
key_concerns: Single cell line (HCT116); no independent replication or generalizability assessment
Wound healing limited functional indicator; no invasion chamber, 3D spheroid, or orthotopic models
Gene list (ZONAB, NDRG1, etc.) association with CLDN2 loss unclear mechanistically
Insufficient data for meaningful translational contribution
chief_reviewer.rationale: Minimal in vitro study insufficient for publication. Requires independent cell line validation and animal models.
